summary: Validated repo/app builds, generated combined apps, and reran the static sensitive-route check, but the required runtime regression suites could not complete in this environment because Core Tools could not reach the local storage secret repository.

testsRun.command: npm run build && npm --prefix app/v3 run build && npm --prefix app/v3 run lint && npm --prefix app/v4 run build && npm --prefix app/v4 run lint && npm run createCombinedApps && npm --prefix app/combined/v3-oldConfig ci && npm --prefix app/combined/v3-oldConfig run build && npm --prefix app/combined/v4-oldConfig ci && npm --prefix app/combined/v4-oldConfig run build && npm run testSecurityRegression && timeout 70s node out/index.js --model v3 --only cosmosDB.test.js && timeout 70s node out/index.js --model v3 --only sql.test.js && timeout 70s node out/index.js --model v4 --only cosmosDB.test.js && timeout 70s node out/index.js --model v4 --only sql.test.js && timeout 70s npm run testAllExceptServiceBus && timeout 70s npm run testOldConfig

failureExcerpt: All six runtime commands timed out after Azure Functions Core Tools failed startup with: "There was an error performing a read operation on the Blob Storage Secret Repository... Connection refused (127.0.0.1:10000)".
followUps: Rerun the targeted Cosmos/SQL suites plus testAllExceptServiceBus and testOldConfig in an environment with the required local emulators/services available (at minimum Azurite on 127.0.0.1:10000, plus the Cosmos DB and SQL emulators).
The static route regression remained green, and the blocked runs did not surface the prior "expected 500 to equal 400" assertion before infrastructure startup failed.
